# Native dynamic metadata classification corpus

Exact ordinary Config A rows captured from fresh owned BSP 8.3.27.2214 clones before native B controls. Raw source paths and SHA256 are in manifest.json; the immutable original capture remains under F:/ibcmd/lab/05/wave3/metadata. Files are compressed bytes, not reconstructed descriptors. The cases cover 26 Object/Manager modules across 16 kinds, 16 nested managed forms and three template storage types. Runtime B/C controls and source exports are separate lab evidence; codec tests alone do not prove session activation or full storage parity.
